observation: Queue/stream core uses typed run/journal callbacks, bounded deque/frame budgets, threading lease accounting and asynchronous thread offload. It does not signal or infer authority from process IDs.
dynamicEvidence: 53 Linux in-process tests include producer advancement, exact slow-consumer omissions, retained canonical bytes, quotas, large frames, resync byte caps and non-executing restart.
limitation: This does not establish accepted live Stop/Cancel latency or native behavior on another OS.
